title: Kilauea Ep49 Ends After 7.5 Hours of Lava Fountaining — The Watchers Report
snippet: Episode 49 erupted June 14, 2026 at 09:36 HST and ended at approximately 17:05 HST. Fountains 213m (700ft), plume 5500m (18,000ft). Alert lowered from WATCH to ADVISORY. Surpassed Pu'u'O'o 1983-86 record of 47 episodes, now at 49 episodes — the most episodic-fountaining eruption ever recorded at Kilauea.
tag_reason: Cross-source for evt-202 Kilauea Ep49. Confirms USGS HVO data with additional historical context.
